title: Five Notch Head And Long Shaft Billiard Bridge
description: One independently authored complete fixed billiards-bridge-stick-inspired prop. A whole finite-thickness transverse fan head has five genuinely open rounded upper grooves at graduated elevations, continuous shoulders and a low underside arch. Two complete dark foot caps root into its full side feet. One long tapered round shaft enters the centre of that head from behind and joins a whole long faceted rear grip; the two foot caps and rear grip have finite flat ground facets in this resting pose. Five complete closed components and three opaque constant PBR roles, metre-style native Z up and bounds-centred ground origin. New numeric head boundary and axial profiles, not a croquet head shortened, a hockey blade extracted or an old shaft recoloured. No cue, balls, table, removable head, screw thread, telescoping joint, text or logo. One original model zero scenes. Static unoccupied visual appearance only: no actual cue guidance, sliding friction, pool rules, regulation size, playability, user reach, fitting, loading, material strength, manufacture or safety capability. No rigging, animation, interaction or external textures.
